    trapp95 rose 21 ms after the shard rebuild

    Queries that touch more than two shards now wait on the slowest one. Retrieval quality is unaffected; the fix is in the fan-out, not the model.

    Notes

    What changed this week

    The index was rebuilt with eight shards instead of four to cut ingest time. Ingest is now 2.1× faster; the cost appears at query time for long-tail questions.

    whyKeep the frozen question set frozen

    Week-over-week numbers only mean something if the questions do not move. New questions go into v4 and run side by side for two weeks first.
